description: Start a credit top-up on the OpenTrain account. No money moves from this call: it returns a Stripe Checkout checkoutUrl that a signed-in human must open and pay (the link expires in ~24h). Once paid, the balance updates automatically — confirm with opentrain_get_credit_top_up or opentrain_get_credits. Amount must be between $10 and $10,000. Requires payments:write scope, a claimed account, and the credits feature.

amountUsd.description: Top-up amount in US dollars (min $10, max $10,000).

name: opentrain_create_credit_top_up
